machine: Apple M1 Max, 32 GB unified memory

implementation.source_weight_storage: approximately 17.5 GB across four BF16 shards
implementation.embedding_policy: read only each requested 8 KiB BF16 row into a compact prompt-sized buffer
implementation.overlap: while Metal executes decoder layer N, one worker reads layer N+1 into the alternate shared Metal buffer
implementation.correctness_note: Safetensors mappings remain metadata-only; GPU weights are byte-identical BF16 payloads copied without conversion

recent_whole_shard_path.description: last pre-F3 integrated text timing from the F4 validation run

standalone_memory_sample.note: timing varies with filesystem and power state; this run is retained primarily as the memory measurement

native_pipeline_256_adjacent.interpretation: the text-phase gain is direct; the end-to-end pair understates it because transformer buffer/prefix setup was 804 ms slower in the overlapped run

quality.comparison: byte-for-byte identical to the pre-F3 v4 PNG

unit_tests.interpretation: environment-sensitive TCP sandbox failures unrelated to the text path; all project tests passed

decision: accept the two-slot streamer; it removes whole-shard readahead, cuts standalone text wall time by about 80.6%, bounds the text working set below 1 GB in the measured run, and preserves the exact downstream PNG
